user.title: Bazaar
user.description: Bazaar shows the repositories HACS can install but does not list yet, in a panel in the sidebar. HACS must be set up, since Bazaar adds repositories to it.

data_description.catalog_url: Where the catalog is fetched from. Keep the default unless you run your own copy.

error.cannot_connect: The catalog could not be fetched from that address.
error.invalid_catalog: That address does not give a catalog this version of Bazaar can read.
